QF.id: Cat III AIF Overview and Growth_6

question.text: A key differentiator of alternative investments vs traditional investments is:

answer.text: Illiquidity; alternative investments are generally NOT readily convertible to cash

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 1.1, alternative investments are characterised by illiquidity (not readily convertible to cash). The Trap: Liquidity/guaranteed returns apply to traditional investments. Cross-Exam Context: Fundamental distinction. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Emphasise illiquidity premium when explaining higher expected returns of alternatives.
